title: Velvety Ukrainian Barley Pilaf
description: A malty, velvety, and light Ukrainian dish featuring onion salt and nuka-pickle, suitable for diabetic-friendly diets
instructions: Rinse the pearl barley in a fine mesh sieve and drain well
In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil and add the barley, reducing heat to low and covering
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped celery and grated carrots until tender
Add the chopped nuka-pickle to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes
Stir in the onion salt and black pepper
Fluff the cooked barley with a fork and stir in the skillet mixture
Serve hot, garnished with additional chopped nuka-pickle if desired
Let cool completely before refrigerating or freezing
Reheat gently over low heat, adding a little water if necessary
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
